name: sdlc-capm-vscode
description: Writes MUFG's PDLC Planning deliverables (BRD, FDD, SIT and UAT QA Strategies, DUT, SIT and UAT cases and the RTM) with GitHub Copilot, with a named owner approving each one, ready for Planview/PPP.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: GitHub Copilot is turned off in Restricted Mode, so documents cannot be written until you trust the folder.

sdlcCapm.model.description: The Copilot model that writes the documents. Empty means Auto: the most capable available model. Easiest to change from the model list in the tool's top bar.

sdlcCapm.reviewerName.description: Your name as it appears in approvals and the audit log. Defaults to your computer user name.

sdlcCapm.autoAdvance.description: Start the next step automatically after an approval.
